items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Johnny Hamp's orchestra will not play the two-learns, but Johnny De Droit's orchestra.

ctx.x: Johnny Hamp's orchestra will not play the two-learns, but Johnny De Droit's orchestra. It turns out they used two bands out at the country club. You know all this country club?
Johnny Hamp played here? Yeah he did.
